GetGlobalVar.description: Reads a global variable (one shared by all actions). The type you ask for, like int, is what you get. Pass false to read a temporary (not saved) one.
GetGlobalVar.returns: The value, or the empty default (like 0) when it is missing or was stored the other way (saved vs temporary).
GetGlobalVar.example:
int deaths = CPH.GetGlobalVar<int>("deaths");
CPH.LogInfo($"Deaths so far: {deaths}");

SetGlobalVar.description: Stores a global variable that every action can read. Saved means it is kept when Cuebot restarts. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

UnsetGlobalVar.description: Deletes a global variable. Pass false to delete a temporary (not saved) one; it only deletes the one stored that way.

GetGlobalVarValues.description: Gives you a list of all saved global variables, each with its name, value and last change. Pass false to list the temporary ones instead.
GetGlobalVarValues.example:
var globals = CPH.GetGlobalVarValues();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {globals.Count} saved globals.");

ClearNonPersistedGlobals.description: Deletes every temporary (not saved) global variable at once. Saved ones stay.

GetTwitchUserVar.description: Reads a Twitch viewer's variable, by their login name. The type you ask for (like int) is what you get. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.
GetTwitchUserVar.returns: The value, or the empty default (like 0 or empty) when the viewer or variable is not found.

GetTwitchUserVarById.description: Reads a Twitch viewer's variable, by their user id. The type you ask for (like int) is what you get. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.
GetTwitchUserVarById.returns: The value, or the empty default (like 0 or empty) when the viewer or variable is not found.

SetTwitchUserVar.description: Stores a variable for one Twitch viewer, by their login name. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

SetTwitchUserVarById.description: Stores a variable for one Twitch viewer, by their user id. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

UnsetTwitchUserVar.description: Deletes one variable of a Twitch viewer, by their login name. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.

UnsetTwitchUserVarById.description: Deletes one variable of a Twitch viewer, by their user id. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.

UnsetAllTwitchUsersVar.description: Deletes one variable from every Twitch viewer at once. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.

GetTwitchUsersVar.description: Gives you a list of every Twitch viewer who has this variable, with their id, name, value and last change. Pass false to list the ones not saved instead.
GetTwitchUsersVar.returns: A list of viewers and their values (empty when nobody has it).
GetTwitchUsersVar.example:
var all = CPH.GetTwitchUsersVar<int>("points");
CPH.LogInfo($"{all.Count} viewers have points.");

GetUserVar.description: Older name for GetTwitchUserVar: reads a Twitch viewer's variable by their login name. The type you ask for is what you get.
GetUserVar.returns: The value, or the empty default (like 0) when not found.

SetUserVar.description: Older name for SetTwitchUserVar: stores a variable for a Twitch viewer by their login name. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

UnsetUserVar.description: Older name for UnsetTwitchUserVar: deletes one variable of a Twitch viewer by their login name.

UnsetUser.description: Deletes all variables of one Twitch viewer, by their login name. Nothing happens when Cuebot does not know them.

UnsetAllUsersVar.description: Deletes one variable from every viewer on every platform (Twitch, YouTube and Kick) at once.

ClearNonPersistedUserGlobals.description: Deletes every temporary (not saved) viewer variable on every platform at once. Saved ones stay.
